about.subtitle: Engineering Profile
about.title: Building scalable ERP systems, web applications & e-commerce platforms.
paragraphs: Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer with over 1.5 years of hands-on experience building ERP systems, web applications, and e-commerce platforms across Vue.js 3, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Laravel / PHP ecosystems.

Experienced in developing scalable frontend and backend solutions, OracleDB & MySQL database management, third-party API integrations (Digital Signatures, Payment Gateways, WhatsApp APIs), and real-time Socket.IO applications — focused on writing maintainable code, improving system performance, and delivering reliable software.

specialization: Vue.js · React · Next.js · Node.js · Laravel · ERP Systems

projects.title: Shamoukh Perfumes — E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack luxury perfume e-commerce platform built with Laravel 13, React 19, and Tailwind CSS featuring a responsive storefront and checkout experience. Includes passwordless user authentication via WhatsApp OTP verification, automated WhatsApp order booking confirmations, and dynamic shipping fee calculation based on customer governorate.

projects.title: Data Tech — IT & Cloud ERP Solutions Platform
projects.description: Bilingual (Arabic/English) corporate and service e-commerce platform for an IT and cloud ERP solutions provider built with Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, and MySQL. Features responsive Blade and Tailwind CSS interfaces showcasing Click ERP systems, e-invoicing solutions, VPS hosting packages, and client support portals, with full production deployment and hosting managed on cPanel.

projects.title: ETA Integration System (E-Invoicing)
projects.description: Full-stack e-invoicing platform built using Node.js and Vue.js, automating Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) tax invoice submissions with secure Digital Signature authentication. Includes a high-speed dashboard for managing invoices, receipts, credit/debit notes, and PDF fetching.

projects.title: Hospital Queue Management System
projects.description: Full-stack hospital queue management system using Vue.js and Node.js, featuring Socket.IO for real-time voice announcements and seamless API integration. Engineered for scalability with OracleDB and Sequelize ORM, including automated reporting modules.

projects.title: Hospital Management System (HMS)
projects.description: Scalable healthcare ERP system managing outpatient clinics, pharmacy, cafeteria, and HR using Vue.js. Streamlines daily hospital operations through a centralized dashboard for real-time data synchronization and department management.

achievements: ETA Integration System (E-Invoicing): Developed a full-stack e-invoicing platform using Node.js and Vue.js, automating tax invoice submissions with secure Digital Signature authentication and a high-speed dashboard for managing invoices, receipts, credit/debit notes, and PDF fetching.

Queue Management System: Developed a full-stack hospital queue system using Vue.js and Node.js with Socket.IO real-time voice announcements, seamless API integration, OracleDB & Sequelize scalability, and automated reporting modules.

Hospital Management System (HMS): Architected a scalable ERP system managing outpatient clinics, pharmacy, cafeteria, and HR using Vue.js, with a centralized dashboard for real-time data synchronization and department management.

Data Tech — IT & Cloud ERP Solutions Platform: Developed a bilingual (Arabic/English) corporate and service e-commerce platform using Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, MySQL, Blade templates, and Tailwind CSS showcasing ERP systems, e-invoicing solutions, VPS hosting packages, and client support portals; configured production deployment, database management, and domain hosting on cPanel.

Whatsavvy — WhatsApp-Integrated Call Center: Developed a high-end call center interface integrated with Green-API, implementing Figma designs into a modern Glassmorphism UI with an optimized Dark Mode.
Built real-time messaging with Socket.IO and call-center reporting dashboards using Vue.js and Bootstrap.
Developed a full-stack perfume e-commerce platform using Laravel 13, React 19, and Tailwind CSS with a responsive storefront and checkout experience.
Implemented passwordless user authentication via WhatsApp OTP verification and automated WhatsApp order booking confirmations for customers.
Engineered dynamic shipping fee calculation based on customer governorate to streamline order processing and delivery pricing.
